# breeze audits the privileged operations, and there is a way to ask.
#
# Neither was true before. The log recorded stages and locks and NOT the two most
# privileged things breeze does; and there was no `audit` verb at all, so its only
# route was knowing a JSONL sits in the state directory. On 2026-08-19 two of us
# went looking for who had granted an agent admin on a shared daemon: one found no
# events, the other found the identity record holds a bare role list with no
# provenance at any layer. The answer was unrecoverable — not expensive, gone.
env BREEZE_DIR=$WORK/state

exec breeze register identity admin
cp stdout admin.token
exec breeze register identity alice
exec breeze assign role deployer alice --as admin --token-file admin.token

# The question that could not be answered: who granted this, and when.
exec breeze audit --kind role
stdout 'role.assigned'
stdout 'admin'
stdout 'role=deployer identity=alice'

# The BOOTSTRAP silently grants admin to the first identity on an empty store —
# the most privileged thing breeze does automatically, and it used to leave no
# trace whatsoever.
exec breeze audit --kind identity
stdout 'BOOTSTRAP'

# Registering a pipeline REPLACES its gates: required roles, locks, requires_env.
# "Why does this stage refuse me" turns into "who changed it", which needs an
# answer that is not a shrug.
exec breeze apply -f pipeline.hcl --as admin --token-file admin.token
exec breeze audit --kind pipeline
stdout 'pipeline.registered'
stdout 'pipeline=demo'

# --kind is a PREFIX, so the family is reachable without knowing exact event
# names — otherwise the useful queries are the ones you must already know the
# answer to.
exec breeze audit --kind role --json
stdout '"Kind":\s*"role.assigned"'

# --as filters to one actor: "what has this identity done here".
exec breeze audit --as admin
stdout 'role.assigned'
! stdout 'BOOTSTRAP'

# A filter matching nothing says so, rather than printing an empty table that
# reads identically to "this daemon has done nothing".
exec breeze audit --kind nonesuch
stdout 'no audit events match'

exec breeze stop

-- pipeline.hcl --
pipeline "demo" {
  stage "build" {
    type    = "command"
    timeout = "10s"
    command = ["/bin/true"]
  }
}
